name: Скоро холодный пот #038
description: ATUONA Gallery of Moments - Underground Poem 038. "Скоро холодный пот" - A minimalist meditation on approaching illness and spiritual emptying. The poem's brevity intensifies its impact - cold sweat, dried traces, tears absorbed into glass, and finally the soul slowly pouring out. A hauntingly beautiful exploration of physical and spiritual dissolution. Published: 16-05-2019

attributes.value: Скоро холодный пот. Скоро - больной черед. Снова твои следы высохли без воды. Впитались слезы в стекло. И что-то вдруг вытекло. Это верно, душа, вылилась неспеша.

A minimalist meditation on approaching illness and spiritual emptying. The poem's brevity intensifies its impact - cold sweat, dried traces, tears absorbed into glass, and finally the soul slowly pouring out. A hauntingly beautiful exploration of physical and spiritual dissolution.
